items.name: Mahamrityunjay Jaap
items.heroSubtitle: A Divine Chant for Health, Protection and Inner Strength
items.heroText: Mahamrityunjay Jaap is a sacred Vedic chant dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is believed to bring protection from negative energies, promote good health, remove fear and bestow peace and longevity in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Shiva Linga with Tripundra, white flowers and lit diyas
items.jaapIntroText: Mahamrityunjay Jaap is one of the most revered mantras in the Vedic tradition, found in the Rigveda. It is dedicated to Lord Shiva, the destroyer of ignorance and the bestower of life, strength and wellbeing. This powerful mantra is chanted to seek divine protection, good health and spiritual upliftment. It is believed to remove fear, reduce the impact of negative energies and bring peace and stability in life.
items.jaapMantra:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे
सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय
मामृतात् ॥

items.heroSubtitle: A Sacred Recitation for Courage, Strength and Divine Guidance
items.heroText: Sundarkand Path is a revered part of the Ramayana that describes the courage, devotion and wisdom of Lord Hanuman. It is performed to seek strength, remove obstacles and receive divine guidance in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Lord Hanuman idol adorned with marigold garlands, with lit brass lamps
items.jaapIntroText: Sundarkand Path is a significant section of the Ramayana, written by Sage Valmiki. It highlights the strength, devotion and intelligence of Lord Hanuman. The recitation of Sundarkand is believed to inspire courage, remove fear and bring positivity into life. It is widely performed by devotees seeking divine support and guidance.

जो दायकु फल चारि ॥

items.name: Durga Saptashati Path
items.heroSubtitle: A Sacred Recitation for Divine Protection, Strength and Positive Transformation
items.heroText: Durga Saptashati Path, also known as Devi Mahatmya, is a powerful recitation dedicated to Goddess Durga. It is performed to seek divine protection, remove obstacles, overcome negative energies and invite courage, prosperity and spiritual strength in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Goddess Durga idol seated on a lion, adorned with flowers and lit diyas
items.jaapIntroText: Durga Saptashati Path is a significant scripture from the Markandeya Purana, consisting of 700 verses that describe the glory, power and divine deeds of Goddess Durga. It highlights the victory of good over evil and the protection of devotees. This path is performed to seek the blessings of Maa Durga for strength, courage, removal of fear and overall well-being.
items.jaapMantra:

शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै
नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥

items.name: Hanuman Chalisa Path
items.heroSubtitle: A Sacred Recitation for Strength, Courage and Protection
items.heroText: Hanuman Chalisa Path is a beautiful devotional recitation dedicated to Lord Hanuman. It is believed to bring strength, protection from negative energies and peace of mind, and helps devotees overcome fear, difficulties and obstacles in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Lord Hanuman idol with folded hands, garlands and lit diyas
items.jaapIntroText: Hanuman Chalisa Path is a revered devotional hymn composed by Goswami Tulsidas. It consists of 40 verses that describe the glory, strength, devotion and virtues of Lord Hanuman. Regular recitation of Hanuman Chalisa is believed to bring courage, remove fear, protect from negative influences and inspire positivity in life. It is widely performed by devotees seeking divine support and guidance.
items.jaapMantra:

अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च
हनुमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत् ॥

items.heroText: Rudrabhishek is a powerful Vedic ritual dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is performed to seek divine blessings for peace, protection, good health, removal of obstacles and overall well-being in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Abhishek of a Shiva Linga decorated with white flowers, with lit brass lamps
items.jaapIntroText: Rudrabhishek is a significant Vedic ritual performed in the honour of Lord Shiva. It involves the ritual bathing (abhishek) of the Shiva Linga with sacred ingredients while chanting Vedic mantras such as the Rudra Mantra and Mahamrityunjay Mantra. This ritual is believed to bring peace, protection, good health, prosperity and spiritual upliftment.

items.heroSubtitle: A Continuous Recitation for Devotion, Strength and a Blessed Life
items.heroText: Akhand Ramayana Path is a continuous recitation of the Shri Ramcharitmanas, performed without interruption. It is believed to remove obstacles, bring peace, prosperity and divine blessings, and create a positive and harmonious environment in life.
items.heroImageAlt: Idols of Lord Rama, Mata Sita and Lakshman with the Ramcharitmanas and lit diyas
items.jaapIntroText: Akhand Ramayana Path is a revered recitation of the Shri Ramcharitmanas, written by Goswami Tulsidas. It is performed continuously, usually over 24 hours or as per tradition, without any interruption. The path is considered highly auspicious and is performed by devotees to seek the blessings of Lord Rama, remove difficulties, bring peace, prosperity and harmony in family and surroundings.
